# Sequence Feature

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:SequenceFeature`](gmeow-SequenceFeature.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/SequenceFeature>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)

A feature or annotation on a biological sequence — a range with start, end, strand, and type, expressed in a reference assembly frame. The first-class entity that carries the coordinates and type; linked to a [`BiologicalSequenceLocation`](gmeow-BiologicalSequenceLocation.md) via [`gmeow:hasSequenceFeature`](../properties/gmeow-hasSequenceFeature.md).
